authority: Agent-drafted under CLAUDE.md, for the operator's decision. Advisory, out-of-band. Adds no runtime gate, amends no constitutional rule, and authorises no transmission until the operator signs the operator_decision block. The fields already filled record decisions the operator stated in session on 2026-10-14; the signature makes them the operator's record.
decision: Adopt Design 1 of the assessment in its bounded form. Jev may be wired into harness/ as an optional, injected typed-decision provider. The cost policy is amended to permit one optional metered provider behind an injected backend and never a required one, and E10's framework list is folded into that rule. What may be sent to Jev is decided per data class (below): synthetic material now; the sanitised and anonymised derivatives only after the vendor's zero-data-retention terms are confirmed in writing; the submitted original, its private records and the Stage B candidate never.
why: The assessment found Jev useful only for short-text classification over supplied evidence, outside the blind lane. Its single blocker for real use is the processing route: TypeSafe processes in the United States, documents no VPC, private-endpoint or EU option, and offers zero data retention to enterprise customers on request only. The private network (ADR-001 Decisions 1-2) cannot reach it, so the route for anything beyond synthetic fixtures runs through derivatives that are safe to process outside that network, under contractual retention terms.

documented: Zero data retention is available for enterprise customers, set up per account on request.
Inputs and outputs are not used to train models.
A SOC 2 Type II report is available on request through the Trust Center.
Processing in the United States (assessment section 4.4); DPA with EU SCCs Module 2 (same).
not_documented: What zero data retention covers: inputs, outputs, request logs, abuse-monitoring copies, backups.
Retention without ZDR (the privacy policy says 'as long as reasonably necessary').
Any VPC, PrivateLink, on-premises or EU-region deployment. The enterprise FAQ asks the question and the page shows no answer.
A deprecation notice period for a pinned model id.

operator_contact.what: The operator contacted TypeSafe about Jev API access with zero data retention for the proposal orchestrator.

questions_the_response_must_answer: Is ZDR confirmed in writing for this account, effective from which date, and does it cover inputs, outputs, logs and abuse-monitoring copies?
Which sub-processors handle request content, and where?
Is the DPA with SCCs executed for this account, and who is the counterparty?
Is a dedicated, VPC or AWS PrivateLink endpoint available, in any region, and in the EU in particular?
What notice is given before jev-1.13.0 is retired?
The SOC 2 Type II report: received and its scope read.

zdr_confirmed.definition: Written confirmation from TypeSafe that zero data retention is active on the account used by TYPESAFE_API_KEY, covering request inputs and outputs, plus an executed DPA. Recorded in a successor decision record naming the document, its date and its hash. A sales email saying ZDR is 'available' does not satisfy this.

data_classes.name: Synthetic and pseudonymous fixtures
members: the BIODIV-01 dev-graph demo candidate and the MSCA-PF graph candidate

data_classes.name: Repository metadata
members: hashes, counts, dates, decision ids, review statuses and command lines, as runbook section 10 already allows the public workspace to hold

data_classes.name: The existing sanitised derivative, the ESR record and harness outputs quoting them
members: frozen reports, comparisons and reviews over the sanitised copy
data_classes.claude_subscription: permitted (already in use under PE-01 to PE-08)
data_classes.condition: zdr_confirmed is Confirmed in a successor record. The ESR text is evaluator commentary about the original proposal and is treated as D2, not D0.

data_classes.name: The accepted anonymised derivative of the original
members: the derivative the planned anonymisation pipeline produces in the private network, once accepted
data_classes.condition: Accepted means: the deterministic redaction and model rewrite ran inside the private network; the re-identification pass found no hit; the operator signed it off; Table 1.4.1 is replaced by a structurally equivalent synthetic table; and its export is permitted by the private environment's own rule (runbook section 10). The acceptance is recorded as its own decision record. Until then the derivative is D4.

data_classes.name: Private material
members: the submitted MSCA-DN original and anything quoting it
the original's configuration input, private graph root and register (V17, V18)
the anonymisation mapping table (original to replacement)
data_classes.claude_subscription: not permitted; Bedrock inside the private network only
data_classes.condition: Changes only through J10, which needs a vendor deployment option that does not exist today, or a separate operator decision to open egress under a DPA with ZDR. Neither is made here.

cost_policy_amendment.summary: An optional metered provider is admitted behind an injected backend. It is never required: the acceptance lane stays green and every test passes with no key; a missing key constructs nothing. Spend is capped per run. E10's four-framework list is retired as a list and replaced by this one rule.

spend_cap.basis: Assessment section 11.5 estimates about $0.40 for the full benchmark at the posted $0.042 per million input tokens. The cap is an order of magnitude above it so it bites only on a runaway loop.

unblocks_when_signed: J1 (decision_provider.py) and J2 (benchmark on synthetic fixtures): D0 only, no ZDR needed
J4, J5, J7 on the BIODIV-01 and MSCA-PF demo candidates (D0)
stays_blocked: J3 and J4/J5 on the sanitised copy: until zdr_confirmed
J3 and J5 on the anonymised derivative: until its acceptance record and zdr_confirmed
not_evidence_of: that TypeSafe has granted zero data retention
that any proposal text has been or may now be sent to TypeSafe
that the anonymised derivative exists or has been accepted
a change to the blind lane, the freeze, the receipt or any runtime gate
